method.lineDefinition: Physical newline-delimited lines; trailing empty final split omitted. Nonempty counts include comments; JS/TS scanner-derived nonemptyExcludingCommentLines is an estimate (scanner lexical context can differ in template/regex/JSX). Function counts are TypeScript AST spans and nested functions overlap. Compressed-function candidates have <250 lines and >=18000 characters. Generated/vendor content not read. Other language functions not AST-measured.
method.consumerAnalysis: Exact static import/export specifier resolution for relative source files and @i-harness/package src/index.ts facades; dynamic imports/reexports through intermediary facades may require follow-up. Native Rust consumers audited separately.

scope: product only; tests/scripts excluded from decomposition
